why: Y is tighter (14-17 weeks against 17-20 for one department of about 140 people), and its final gate asks for a decision the COO and Head of Claims can actually take, while X's week 20 gate asks them for an executive committee approval they cannot give. Y should still borrow X's W2 capture of the committee's approval requirements and add a dated committee step, because neither plan secures the stated success criterion within its own governance.
